title: Spacious
summary: SPA'CIOUS, adjective [Latin spatiosus.] 1. Wide; roomy; having large or ample room; not narrow; as a spacious church; a spacious hall or drawing room. 2. Extensive; vast in extent; as the spacious ear

inlines.v: SPA'CIOUS, adjective [Latin spatiosus.] 1. Wide; roomy; having large or ample room; not narrow; as a spacious church; a spacious hall or drawing room. 2. Extensive; vast in extent; as the spacious earth; the spacious ocean.
